The modeled version-1 state and connection-decision enumerations each contain five pairwise distinct constructors.
The executable coreDone Boolean is true exactly when all seventeen abstract CoreDone conditions hold.
After the separately modeled consumer admission checks, the deterministic selector returns DONE exactly under the disclosed priority-clear and CoreDone conditions.
Within the post-admission selector, predecessor failure, deadline, absent effect-checkable reception, integrity failure, explicit BLOCK and explicit ISOLATE obey the modeled Draft-01 priority order.
Ordinary authorization implies all modeled consumer checks, a recorded DONE and a DONE recomputed from the supplied snapshot.
A non-DONE record and a record marked stale cannot satisfy the modeled ordinary-release authorization predicate.
A concrete snapshot with transport acknowledgement but no effect-checkable reception selects NACK and is not authorized.
Under complete mediation, every scoped ordinary executor invocation implies a recorded DONE and a DONE recomputed from the supplied snapshot.
Under complete mediation and a faithful causal bridge, every scoped physical occurrence has a causing executor invocation with recorded DONE and DONE recomputed from the supplied snapshot.
A target meaning is reconstructible on the observation image exactly when it is constant on every observation fiber.
Exact historical reconstruction by a left inverse requires an injective observation.
A collapsed observation of two distinguishable Boolean sources admits no exact decoder.
Full Draft-01 wire parsing, closed-schema handling, JCS/SHA-256 behavior, version negotiation, authentication and independent interoperability remain outside this Lean model.
Hardware correctness, sensor and actuator trust, calibrated measurement, fault coverage and physical safety require empirical evidence and are not consequences of the software proof.

Neither Draft-01 nor this formalization establishes a universal decoder, recovery of all lost information, all mathematics, all physics or the entire universe; the separate collapsed-observation theorem proves only a concrete general inversion boundary.
